web.grid.intro: GridLink brings power and home phone service to every street in {city}. The map below shows each sector right now.
From the docks to downtown, one company keeps the lights on and the home phones ringing. Here is the grid as it stands.
Your power and your home phone, from one company you can call. This is how the city looks right now.
web.grid.safety: Stay away from fallen lines and never open a GridLink box.
Our boxes on the poles carry high voltage. Leave them to our crews.
See a damaged box or a line down? Keep clear and call us.
web.grid.report: When the lights go out, we usually know already: our control room watches every sector. Still, your call helps us find the trouble faster.
Our control room sees most outages the moment they happen, but a call from you helps the crews find the spot.
web.grid.about: GridLink Power & Telecom has served {city} since 1961. Today {n} substations feed the city, each one its own sector, run from our control room downtown.
Founded in 1961, GridLink runs {city}'s power grid and its home phone lines: {n} substations, {n} sectors, and the crews who answer at any hour.
